limits: Tracing overhead is included; compare the paired untraced workload.
Elapsed syscalls and scheduling intervals need interpretation, not automatic causal labels.
Main-thread direct-IPC diagnostic only; no native/finger/optical or portrait acceptance.
Selected function entries identify a source-grounded conservative held-lock interval, not exact acquisition/release timestamps or mutex addresses.
Poll detection time includes all work inside the interval; the internal I2C or bridge operation consuming that time remains unmeasured.
Prior kernel sleep stacks locate these DRM call paths in modeset mutex acquisition; this run measures scheduler/syscalls and the polling critical section, without new kernel sleep stacks.

correlation.held_interval_definition: detect_connector_status entry to drm_modeset_drop_locks entry in the same complete output_poll_execute/probe/LT9611 worker path; conservative connection_mutex-held interval grounded in pinned kernel source
